## About Designit

Designit is a senior-led, research-led product design studio in Noida, India. It helps SaaS, technology and enterprise teams understand their users, simplify complex products, redesign experiences and build scalable design systems, working with clients in India and the UAE and taking on projects for teams in the United States and the United Kingdom.

Designit Studio (designit.co.in) is independent and not affiliated with Designit A/S (Wipro).

- Founder: Sahil Sharma ([LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/best-design-studio/))
- Email: contact@designit.co.in
- Start a project: [https://designit.co.in/start-a-project/](https://designit.co.in/start-a-project/)
